G2500G.def:
Ἰωσῆς, -ῆ (Rec. -ή Luc 3:29; AV, Jose; see: Ἰησοῦς, 3), and -ῆτος (Mk, ll with), ὁ, 
Joses; 
__1. brother of our Lord: Marc 6:3, Matthieu 13:55 (Rec., see: Ἰωσήφ). 
__2. Son of Mary: Matthieu 27:56 (-σήφ), WH, txt), Marc 15:40, 47 
__3. see: Βαρνάβας.†

G2501G.def:
Ἰωσήφ indecl. 
(FlJ, Ἰώσηπος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. יוֹסֵף), 
Joseph; 
__1. the Son of Jacob: Jean 4:5, Actes 7:9, 13-14 7:18, Hébreux 11:21-22, Apocalypse 7:8. 
__2. In the genealogy of our Lord, 
__(a) the son of Matthias: Luc 3:24; 
__(b) the son Joram: Luc 3:30. 
__3. The husband of Mary, the Lord's mother Matthieu 1:16 ff, Luc 1:27, Jean 1:46, al. 
__4. One of the brethren of our Lord (see: ἀδελφός): Matthieu 13:55. 
__5. Son of Mary: Matthieu 27:56 (-σῆς, WH, mg., RV). 
__6. Joseph of Arimatbæa: Matthieu 27:57, 59, Marc 15:43, 45, Luc 23:50, Jean 19:38. 
__7. see: Βαρνάβας. 
__8. see: Βαρσαβᾶς

G2502.def:
Ἰωσείας (-σίας, Rec.), -ου, ὁ (Heb. יֹאשִׁיָּה), 
Josiah: Matthieu 1:10-11 †

G2503.def:
ἰῶτα, τό ,
iota (Heb. י, i.e. the smallest letter): Matthieu 5:18.†

G2505.def:
καθά
adv. (for καθ᾽ ἅ), [in LXX: Genèse 7:9 19:8, al. (אֲשֶׁר, כְּ), Ésaïe 58:11, Wis.3:10, al. ;] 
just as, according as: Matthieu 27:10 (LXX), Luc 1:2, D (cf. BL, § 78, 1; Phil. Gosp., 8 f.).†

G2506.def:
καθ-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(καθαιρέω), [in LXX: Exode 23:24 (הָרַס), 1Ma.3:43 * ;] 
a pulling down, destruction: figuratively, κ. ὀχυρωμάτων, 2 Corinthiens 10:4; opposite to οἰκοδομή, 2 Corinthiens 10:8 13:10.†

G2507.def:
καθ-αιρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for נָתַץ, פָּרַץ, יָרַד, etc. ;] 
__1. to take down: with accusative of person(s) (the technical term for removal after crucifixion, Field, Notes, 44), Marc 15:36, 46, Luc 23:53, Actes 13:29. 
__2. to put down by force, pull down, destroy: ἀποθήκας, Luc 12:18 (opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν); δυνάστας, Luc 1:52; ἔθνη, Actes 13:19; pass., Actes 19:27 (diminished, Field, Notes, 129 f.); figuratively, to refute: λογισμούς, 2 Corinthiens 10:5.†

G2508.def:
καθαίρω
(καθαρός), [in LXX: Ésaïe 28:27 (דּוּשׁ ho.), 2 Rois 4:6, Jérémie 51:39 א* ;] 
to cleanse: of pruning, Jean 15:2 (cf. καθαρίζω).†

G2509.def:
καθάπερ (for καθ᾽ ἅπερ = καθά) adv., 
[in LXX for אֲשֶׁר, Genèse 12:4, Exode 7:6, al. ;] 
just as, even as: Romains 3:4 4:6 9:13 10:15 11:8 12:4, 1 Corinthiens 10:10 12:12, 2 Corinthiens 1:14 3:13 3:18 8:11, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:11 3:6 3:12 4:6, Hébreux 4:2.†

G2510.def:
καθ-άπτω 
[in Sm.: Cantique des cantiques 1:6 * ;] 
__1. to fasten on, put upon, with accusative 
__2. Act. for mid. (cf. Bl., § 53, 3), to lay hold of, attack: with genitive, χειρός, Actes 28:3.†

G2511.def:
καθαρίζω
(Hellenistic-FlJ, Inscr.-for Attic καθαίρω, which see, on the vulgar -ερ-, Matthieu 8:3, Marc 1:42, see Bl., § 6, 1; Thackeray, Gr., 74) [in LXX chiefly for טָהֵר ;] 
to cleanse, make clean. 
__1. In physical sense: with accusative of thing(s), figuratively, Matthieu 23:25-26, Luc 11:39; of disease (leprosy), with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 8:2-3 10:8 11:5, Marc 1:40-42 Luc 4:27 5:12-13 7:22 17:14, 17; ἡ λέπρα ἐκαθερίσθη (on the spelling see supr.), Matthieu 8:3. 
__2. In ethical sense: τ. καρδίας, Actes 15:9 (cf. Sir.38:10); τ. χεῖρας, Jacques 4:8; λαὸν ἑαυτῷ, Tite 2:14; τ. ἐκκλησίαν, Éphésiens 5:26; with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), before ἀπό (131., § 36, 9; Deiss., BS, 216 f.), 2 Corinthiens 7:1, Hébreux 9:14, 1 Jean 1:7 Jn 1:9. 
__3. In ceremonial sense: Marc 7:19, Actes 10:15 11:9, Hébreux 9:22-23 10:2 (cf. δια-καθαρίζω).†

G2512.def:
καθαρισμός, -oῦ, τό
(καθαρίζω). [in LXX for טָהֵר, טׇהֳרָה, etc. ;] 
cleansing, purification: Jean 3:25; with genitive subjc., τ. Ἰουδαίων, Jean 2:6; with genitive obj., of women after childbirth, Luc 2:22; of lepers, Marc 1:44, Luc 5:14; with genitive of thing(s), τ. ἁμαρτιῶν, Hébreux 1:3, 2 Pierre 1:9 (Cremer, 319).†

G2513.def:
καθαρός, -ά, -όν 
[in LXX chiefly for טָהוֹר ;] 
pure, clean. 
__1. Physically: Matthieu 23:26 27:59, Jean 13:10-11 (fig.), Jean 15:3 (figuratively, as of a vine cleansed by pruning), Hébreux 10:22, Apocalypse 15:6 19:8, 14 21:18, 21. 
__2. Ceremonially: Luc 11:41, Romains 14:20, Tite 1:15. 
__3. Ethically; 
__(a) of persons: Jean 13:16, Actes 18:6, Tite 1:15; ό κ. τῇ καρδίᾳ (καθαρὸς χεῖρας, Hdt., i, 35), Matthieu 5:8; before ἀπό (cl. with genitive simp.; ΒΙ., § 36, 11; Deiss., BS, 196; MM, Exp., xv), Actes 20:26; 
__(b) of things: καρδία, 1 Timothée 1:6, 2 Timothée 2:22; συνείδησις, 1 Timothée 3:9, 2 Timothée 1:3; θρησκεία, Jacques 1:27.†
SYN.: see: ἁγνός.

G2514.def:
καθαρότης, -ητος, ἡ
(καθαρός), [in LXX: Exode 24:10 (טֹהַר), Wis.7:24 * ;] 
purity, cleanness: with genitive, Hébreux 9:13.†

G2515.def:
καθ-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(κατά, + ἔδρα, a seat) [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב and cogn. forms ;] 
a chair, seat: Matthieu 21:12, Marc 11:16; of teachers, Matthieu 23:2.†

G2516.def:
καθ-έζομαι 
[in LXX: Lévitique 12:5, al. (יָשַׁב), Job 39:28 (שָׁכַן) ;] 
to sit down, sit: Jean 20:12; before ἐν, Matthieu 26:55, Luc 2:46, Jean 11:20, Actes 6:15; before ἐπί, with genitive, Actes 20:9; id. with dative, Jean 4:6 (cf. παρα-καθέζ-, κάθημαι).†
καθ ̓ εἷς, see: (εἷς.)

G2517.def:
καθ-εξῆς
(= cl. ἑξῆς, ἐφεξῆς) 
adv., 
__1. successively, in order: Luc 1:3, Actes 11:4 18:23; τῶν κ.. (those that succeeded him), Actes 3:24. 
__2. after­wards: ἐν τῷ κ. (sc. χρόνῳ), Luc 8:1.†

G2518.def:
καθεύδω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב, Genèse 28:13, Psaumes 88:5, al.; also for יָשֵׁן, Cantique des cantiques 5:2, Dan LXX TH Daniel 12:2, al.; for יָשַׁב, 1 Rois 19:9 ;] 
to sleep: Matthieu 8:24 9:24 13:25 25:5 26:46, 43 26:45, Marc 4:27, 38 5:39 14:37, 40-41, Luc 8:52 22:46, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:7. Metaphorical, 
__(a) of death (as Ps, Da, ll. with): 1 Thessaloniciens 5:10 (cf. Matthieu 9:24, Marc 5:39, Luc 8:52, and see Swete, Mk., l.with); 
__(b) of moral and spiritual insensibility: Marc 13:36, Éphésiens 5:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:6.†
SYN.: (κοιμάω.)

G2519.def:
καθηγητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(καθηγέομαι, to go before, guide), 
__1. prop., a guide. 
__2. a master, teacher (MGr. professor): Matthieu 23:16.†

G2520.def:
καθ-ήκω 
[in LXX: impers., Lévitique 5:16, Eze.21:27 (32), al. (מִשְׁפָּט); τὰ κ., Exode 5:13, al. (דָבַר), etc. ;] 
__1. to come down, come to. 
__2. to be fit, proper: impers., with accusative and inf., Actes 22:22 (on the tense, see Bl., § 63, 4); τὰ μὴ καθήκοντα, Romains 1:28.†

G2521.def:
κάθ-ημαι 
[in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁב ;] 
in cl. present and imperfect only (prop. pf. and plpf. of καθέζομαι; cf. Bl., § 24), in LXX and NT fut. also, to sit, be seated: Matthieu 11:16 22:44" (LXX), Marc 2:6, Jean 6:3, Actes 2:2, Jacques 2:3 (on the vulgar imper. κάθου, see Kennedy, Sources, 162), Apocalypse 4:3, al.; before prep. with accusative, ἐπί, Matthieu 9:9, Marc 2:14, Jean 12:16; παρά, Matthieu 13:1, Marc 10:46; περί, Marc 3:32, 34; πρός, Luc 22:56; ὑπό, Jacques 2:3; εἰς, Marc 13:3; μετά, with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 26:58; ἐκ δεξιῶν, Matthieu 22:44; ἐπάνω, with genitive, Matthieu 28:2; ἀπέναντι, with genitive, Matthieu 27:61; ἐπί, with dative, Actes 3:10; id. with genitive, Actes 8:28; ἐκεῖ, Matthieu 15:29; pleonastic (M, Pr., 230, 241; Dalman, Words, 22), Matthieu 13:2, Actes 23:3, Apocalypse 18:7; metaphorically, Matthieu 4:16, Luc 1:79" (LXX) ; of one's domicile (Néhémie 11:6, Sir.50:26; Hdt., v, 63), Luc 21:31, Actes 2:2, Apocalypse 14:6 (cf. συν-κάθημαι)

G2522.def:
καθημερινός, -ή, -όν
(καθ ̓ ἡμέραν), [in LXX: Jdth.12:15 * ;] 
daily (MGr. καθημερνός): Actes 6:1.†

G2523.def:
καθ-ίζω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁב ;] 
__1. causal, to make to sit down, set, appoint: Actes 2:30, 1 Corinthiens 6:4, Éphésiens 1:20. 
__2. Intrans., to sit down, be seated, sit: Matthieu 5:1, Marc 9:35, Luc 7:15, Jean 8:2, al.; with inf. tel., 1 Corinthiens 10:7; before εἰς, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:4; ἐπί, with accusative, Marc 11:2, Jean 12:14; id. with genitive, Jean 19:13, Actes 12:21; ὧδε, Marc 14:32; αὐτοῦ, Matthieu 26:36; ἐν δεξιᾷ, Hébreux 1:3; ἐκ δεξιῶν, Matthieu 20:21, 23; ἐν, Apocalypse 3:21; καθίσας pleonastic (M, Proverbes 14:1-35; Dalman, Words, 22), Matthieu 13:48, Luc 5:3 14:31 16:6; of settling in a place (ἐς χωρίον, Thuc., iv, 93), before ἐν, Luc 24:49 (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπι-, παρα-, περι-, συν-καθίζω)

G2524.def:
καθ-ίημι 
[in LXX: Exode 17:11 (נוּחַ hi.), and seel., 1 Chroniques 21:27, Zacharie 11:13, Jérémie 32:14 * ;] 
to send or let down: before εἰς, Luc 5:19; διά, with genitive, ib., Actes 9:25; ptcp., before ἐπί, with genitive, Actes 10:11; ἐκ, Actes 11:5.†

G2525.def:
καθ-ίστημι
(and καθιστάνω, Actes 17:15), [in LXX for פָּקַד, קוּם, שׂוּם, etc., 24 words in all* ;] 
__1. 
__(a) to set down; 
__(b) to bring down to a place (Hom., Xen., al.; 2 Chroniques 28:15, 1 Rois 5:3): Actes 17:15. 
__2. to set in order, appoint, make, constitute: Tite 1:5, 2 Pierre 1:8; with dupl. accusative, κριτήν, Luc 12:14; ἡγούμενον, Actes 7:10; ἄρχοντα, Actes 7:27, 35" (LXX) ; ἀρχιερεῖς, Hébreux 7:28; before ἐπί, with genitive, Matthieu 24:45 25:21, 23, Luc 12:42, Actes 6:3; id. with dative, Matthieu 24:47, Luc 12:44; id. with accusative, Hébreux 2:7 (LXX) (WH, R, mg. omit); pass. (see Mayor, Ja., 115 f.), Romains 5:19, Jacques 3:6 4:4; before εἰς with inf., Hébreux 8:3; τὰ πρὸς τ. θεόν, Hébreux 5:1 (cf. ἀντι-, ἀπο-καθίστημι).
†

G2526.def:
καθό
(= καθ᾽ ὅ), 
adv., [in LXX: Lévitique 9:5, 15 (אֲשֶׁר), I Esther 1:50, Sir.16:20 Bar.1:6, 2Ma.4:16 * ;] 
as, according as: Romains 8:26, 2 Corinthiens 8:12, 1 Pierre 4:13.†

G2527.def:
καθόλου
(= καθ᾽ ὅλον and so in cl. bef. Arist.) 
adv., [in LXX: Exode 22:11(10) Amos 3:3-4; Eze.13:3, 22 17:14 (τὸ κ, μή = בִּלְתִּי), Dan LXX TH Daniel 3:50* ;] 
on the whole, in general: μή κ., not at all, Actes 4:18.†

G2528.def:
καθ-οπλίζω 
[in LXX: Jérémie 46:9 (תָּפַשׂ), Mac.9* ;] 
to arm fully: pass., Luc 11:21.†

G2529.def:
καθ-οράω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Nombres 24:2 (רָאָה), Job 10:4 39:26, 3Ma.3:11 * ;] 
__1. to look down. 
__2. to discern clearly: Romains 1:20.†

G2530.def:
καθότι
(= καθ᾽ ὅ τι), 
adv., [in LXX: Exode 1:12, 17 (אֲשֶׁר), Tob.1:12, Jdth.2:13, al. ;] 
__1. in dl., according as, just as (Ex, l.with): Actes 2:45 4:35. 
__2. In late Gk. = διότι (Tob, l.with), because: Luc 1:7 19:9, Actes 2:24 17:31.†

G2531.def:
καθώς, (i.e. καθ᾽ ὡς), Hellenistic for καθά, which see, καθάπερ, καθό, καθότι (Mayser, 485; Eutherford, NPhr., 495; Bl., §78, 1), 
according as, even as, just as, as: Luc 1:2 (see: καθά), 24:39, Jean 5:23, Actes 7:48, 1 Corinthiens 8:2, Galates 3:6, al.; before οὕτως, Luc 11:30, Jean 3:14, 2 Corinthiens 1:5, Colossiens 3:13, 1 Jean 2:6, al.; before καί, Jean 15:9, 1 Corinthiens 15:49, 1 Jean 2:18, al.; οὕτως . . . κ., Luc 24:24; id. with ellipsis of οὕτως, Matthieu 21:6, Marc 16:7, Romains 1:13, al.; with other elliptical constructions, Jean 6:58 17:21, 22 Actes 15:8, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:13, 1 Timothée 1:3, 1 Jean 3:2, 3 12; καθὼς γέγραπται (Deiss., BS, 249), Matthieu 26:24, Marc 9:13, Romains 1:17, al.; introducing subst. clause as object of verb (as in Heb.), Matthieu 21:6, Marc 11:6, Luc 5:14, al.; after verbs of speaking, Actes 15:14; of proportion and degree, Marc 4:33, 1 Corinthiens 12:11, 18 al.; of time (Néhémie 5:6, 2Ma.1:31), Actes 7:17.

G2533G.def:
Καιάφας (T, Καϊ-), -α ὁ, 
Caiaphas (on the name, see Exp. Times, x, 185): Matthieu 26:3, 57, Luc 3:2, Jean 11:4 18:13-14, 24 18:28 Actes 4:6.†
Καΐφας, for Καιάφας, which see: Luc 3:2 (L)

G2535.def:
Καίν
(Τ, Κάϊν), ὁ, 
indecl. 
(in FlJ, Κάϊς, -ιος), (Heb. קַיִן; Genèse 4:1), 
Cain: Hébreux 11:4, 1 Jean 3:12, Ju 11.†

G2536G.def:
Καινάμ (T, Καϊ-; Rec. Καϊνάν), ό, indecl. (Heb. קֵינָן), 
Cainam, Cainan; 
__1. son of Enos (Genèse 5:9): Luc 3:37. 
__2. Son of Arphaxad (Genèse 10:24 (LXX): Luc 3:36.†

G2536H.def:
Καινάμ (T, Καϊ-; Rec. Καϊνάν), ό, indecl. (Heb. קֵינָן), 
Cainam, Cainan; 
__1. son of Enos (Genèse 5:9): Luc 3:37. 
__2. Son of Arphaxad (Genèse 10:24 (LXX): Luc 3:36.†

G2537.def:
καινός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX (Eze.11:19, al.) for חָדָשׁ, exc. Ésaïe 65:15 (אַחֵר) ;] 
of that which is unused or unaccustomed, new in respect to form or quality, fresh, unused, novel: opposite to παλαιός, ἀρχαῖος, Matthieu 9:17 13:52, Marc 2:21-22 Luc 5:36, 38, 2 Corinthiens 5:17, Éphésiens 4:24; πλήρωμα, Marc 2:21; μνημεῖον, Matthieu 27:60, Jean 19:41; διαθήκη (T, WH, R, txt., omit), Luc 22:20, 1 Corinthiens 11:25, 2 Corinthiens 3:6, Hébreux 8:8" (LXX), Hébreux 8:13 9:15; οὐρανοί, γῆ, 2 Pierre 3:13, Apocalypse 21:1" (LXX) Ἰερουσαλήμ, Apocalypse 3:12 21:2; ἄνθρωπος, Éphésiens 2:15 (cf. Eze.18:31); πάντα, Apocalypse 21:5; γέννημα τ. ἀμπέλου, Matthieu 26:29, Marc 14:25; διδαχή, Marc 1:27, Actes 17:19; ἐντολή, Jean 13:34, 1 Jean 2:7-8, 2Jn.5; ὄνομα, Apocalypse 2:17 (LXX); ᾠδή, Apocalypse 5:9 14:3 (of. Psaumes 144:9); κτίσις, 2 Corinthiens 5:17, Galates 6:15; γλῶσσαι, Marc 16:17; compar., Actes 17:21.†
SYN.: νέος, "the new primarily in reference to time, the young, recent; κ. . the new primarily in reference to quality, the fresh, unworn". Cf. Tr., Syn., § lx (the distinction, however, is less marked in late Gk.; cf. Hébreux 12:24 with He, ll. with supr., and see MM, Exp., xv)

G2538.def:
καινότης, -ητος, ἡ
(καινός), [in LXX: 3Ki.8:53, Eze.47:12 * ;] 
__1. novelty (Thuc., Isocr., LS, see word). 
__2. freshness, newness: ἐν κ. ζωῆς (see Lft., Notes, 296), Romains 6:4; ἐν κ. πνεύματος, Romains 7:6.†

G2539.def:
καίπερ concessive particle, 
[in LXX: Proverbes 6:8, Wis.11:9, Jonas 1:13, Mac.11 * ;] 
although: with ptcp., Philippiens 3:4, Hébreux 5:8 7:5 12:17, 2 Pierre 1:12.†

G2540.def:
καιρός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for עֵת, also for מוֹעֵד, etc. ;] 
__1. due measure, fitness, proportion (Eur., Xen., al.). 
__2. Of Time (cl. also) in the sense of a fixed and definite period, time, season (Kennedy, Sources, 153): Matthieu 11:25, Marc 1:15, Luc 21:8, Romains 13:11, Éphésiens 6:18, Hébreux 11:15, 1 Pierre 1:5 1:11 Apocalypse 1:3, al.; with genitive, πειρασμοῦ Luc 8:13; τ. καρπῶν, Matthieu 21:34; σύκων, Marc 11:13; pl., Matthieu 21:41; χρόνοι ἢ (καὶ) κ., Actes 1:7, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:1; ἐθνῶν, Luc 21:24; of opportune or seasonable time, Actes 24:25, Galates 6:10, Éphésiens 5:16, Colossiens 4:5; with inf., Hébreux 11:15; ὁ κ. οὗτος, Marc 10:30, Luc 18:30; ὁ νῦν κ. (Dalman, Words, 148), Romains 8:18; ὁ κ. ὁ ἐμός, Jean 7:6; κ. δεκτῲ, 2 Corinthiens 6:2 (LXX); δουλεύειν τῷ κ., Romains 12:11, R, mg.; τ. σημεῖα τῶν κ., Matthieu 16:3; adverbial usages: ἐν κ., Matthieu 24:45, 1 Pierre 5:6 (cf. καιρῷ, Luc 20:10; τῷ κ., Marc 12:2); ἄχρι καιροῦ, Luc 4:13; πρὸς καιρόν, Luc 8:13, 1 Corinthiens 7:5; κατὰ καιρόν, Romains 5:6; πρὸ καιροῦ, Matthieu 8:29 
SYN.: (χρόνος) time in the sense of duration

G2541G.def:
Καῖσαρ, -αρος, ὁ 
Cæsar: Matthieu 22:17, Luc 2:1, Jean 19:12, Actes 25:8 ff., al

G2541H.def:
Καῖσαρ, -αρος, ὁ 
Cæsar: Matthieu 22:17, Luc 2:1, Jean 19:12, Actes 25:8 ff., al

G2541I.def:
Καῖσαρ, -αρος, ὁ 
Cæsar: Matthieu 22:17, Luc 2:1, Jean 19:12, Actes 25:8 ff., al

G2541J.def:
Καῖσαρ, -αρος, ὁ 
Cæsar: Matthieu 22:17, Luc 2:1, Jean 19:12, Actes 25:8 ff., al

G2542G.def:
Καισαρία (Rec. -άρεια), -ας, ἡ 
Cæsarea; 
__1. Cæsarea Philippi, at the foot of Lebanon: Matthieu 16:13, Marc 8:27. 
__2. Cæsarea of Palestine, on the sea-coast: Actes 8:4 9:30 10:1, 24 11:11 12:19 18:22 21:8, 16 23:23, 33 25:1, 4 25:6, 13.†

G2542H.def:
Καισαρία (Rec. -άρεια), -ας, ἡ 
Cæsarea; 
__1. Cæsarea Philippi, at the foot of Lebanon: Matthieu 16:13, Marc 8:27. 
__2. Cæsarea of Palestine, on the sea-coast: Actes 8:4 9:30 10:1, 24 11:11 12:19 18:22 21:8, 16 23:23, 33 25:1, 4 25:6, 13.†

G2545.def:
καίω 
[in LXX for בָּעַר, יָקַד, שָׂרַף, etc. ;] 
__1. to kindle, light: with accusative, λύχνον, Matthieu 5:15; pass., to be lighted, to burn: ptcp., Luc 12:35, Apocalypse 4:5 8:10 19:20; πυρί Hébreux 12:18, Apocalypse 8:8 21:8; metaphorically, Luc 24:32, Jean 5:35. 
__2. to burn, destroy by fire: pass., Jean 15:6, 1 Corinthiens 13:3.†

G2549.def:
κακία, -ας, ἡ
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;] 
__1. badness in quality (opposite to ἀρετή, excellence). 
__2. wickedness, depravity, malignity: Actes 8:22, Romains 1:29, 1 Corinthiens 5:8 14:20, Éphésiens 4:31, Colossiens 3:8, Tite 3:3, Jacques 1:21, 1 Pierre 2:1 2:16. 
__3. In late Gk., evil, trouble, affliction (Amos 3:6, 1 Rois 6:9, Ecclésiaste 7:15, Sir.19:6, al.): Matthieu 6:34 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
SYN.: (πονηρία)

G2550.def:
κακοήθεια (WH, -θία), -ας, ἡ 
(κακός, ἦθος), [in LXX: Esther 8:13, 3Ma.3:22 3Mac 7:3 A, 4Ma.1:4 4Mac 3:4 * ;] 
malignity, malevolence: Romains 1:29 (Cremer, 329).†

G2551.def:
κακολογέω, -ῶ
(κακολόγος, slanderous), [in LXX: Exode 21:16 22:28, 1 Rois 3:13, Proverbes 20:20, Eze.22:7 (קָלַל pi., hi.), 2Ma.4:1 * ;] 
to speak ill of, revile, abuse: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 15:4, Marc 7:10" (LXX) Marc 9:39; with accusative of thing(s), Actes 19:9.†

G2552.def:
κακοπάθεια (WH, -θία), -ας, ἡ 
(κακοπαθής, suffering), [in LXX: Malachie 1:13 (תְּלָאָה), תְּלָאָה), 2Ma.2:26-27, 4Ma.9:8 * ;] 
distress, affliction: Jacques 5:10.†

G2553.def:
κακοπαθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Jonas 4:10 (עָמָל)* ;] 
to suffer evil, endure Affliction: 2 Timothée 2:9 4:5, Jacques 5:13.†

G2554.def:
κακο-ποιέω, ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi. ;] 
to do harm, to do evil: Marc 3:4, Luc 6:9, 1 Pierre 3:17, 3Jn.11 (Cremer, 329).†

G2555.def:
κακοποιός, -όν
(κακόν, ποιέω), [in LXX: Proverbes 12:4 (בּוּשׁ hi.) Proverbes 24:19 (רָעַע hi.)* ;] 
doing evil; as susbt., an evil-doer: 1 Pierre 2:12 2:14 4:15.†

G2556G.def:
κακός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX chiefly for רַע ;] 
__1. in general, opposite to ἀγαθός, καλός, in various senses, bad, mean, base, worthless (cl.). 
__2. In ethical sense, base, evil, wicked: of persons, Matthieu 21:41 24:48, Philippiens 3:2, Apocalypse 2:2; διαλογισμοί, Marc 7:21; ὁμιλίαι, 1 Corinthiens 15:33; ἐπιθυμία (Proverbes 12:12), Colossiens 3:5; ἔργον, Romains 13:3; neut., κακόν, τὸ κ., evil: Jean 18:23, Actes 23:9, Romains 7:21 14:20 16:19, 1 Corinthiens 13:5, Hébreux 5:14, 1 Pierre 3:10-11, 3Jn.11; pl., Romains 1:30, 1 Corinthiens 10:6, 1 Timothée 6:10, Jacques 1:13; κ. (τὸ, τὰ κ.) ποιεῖν (πράσσειν), Matthieu 27:23, Marc 15:14, Luc 23:22, Jean 18:30, Romains 3:8 7:19 13:4, 2 Corinthiens 13:7, 1 Pierre 3:12; κατεργάζεσθαι, Romains 2:9; of wrongs inflicted, Actes 9:13, Romains 12:17, 21 13:10, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:15, 2 Timothée 4:14, 1 Pierre 3:9. 
__3. pernicious, harmful, evil: Luc 16:25, Actes 16:28 28:5, Tite 1:12, Jacques 3:8, Apocalypse 16:2 (Cremer, 325, 741).
† SYN.: see: (ἄθεσμος)

G2556H.def:
κακός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX chiefly for רַע ;] 
__1. in general, opposite to ἀγαθός, καλός, in various senses, bad, mean, base, worthless (cl.). 
__2. In ethical sense, base, evil, wicked: of persons, Matthieu 21:41 24:48, Philippiens 3:2, Apocalypse 2:2; διαλογισμοί, Marc 7:21; ὁμιλίαι, 1 Corinthiens 15:33; ἐπιθυμία (Proverbes 12:12), Colossiens 3:5; ἔργον, Romains 13:3; neut., κακόν, τὸ κ., evil: Jean 18:23, Actes 23:9, Romains 7:21 14:20 16:19, 1 Corinthiens 13:5, Hébreux 5:14, 1 Pierre 3:10-11, 3Jn.11; pl., Romains 1:30, 1 Corinthiens 10:6, 1 Timothée 6:10, Jacques 1:13; κ. (τὸ, τὰ κ.) ποιεῖν (πράσσειν), Matthieu 27:23, Marc 15:14, Luc 23:22, Jean 18:30, Romains 3:8 7:19 13:4, 2 Corinthiens 13:7, 1 Pierre 3:12; κατεργάζεσθαι, Romains 2:9; of wrongs inflicted, Actes 9:13, Romains 12:17, 21 13:10, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:15, 2 Timothée 4:14, 1 Pierre 3:9. 
__3. pernicious, harmful, evil: Luc 16:25, Actes 16:28 28:5, Tite 1:12, Jacques 3:8, Apocalypse 16:2 (Cremer, 325, 741).
† SYN.: see: (ἄθεσμος)

G2557.def:
κακοῦργος, -ον
(contr. from epic κακόεργος), [in LXX. Proverbes 21:15 (אָוֶן, פָּעַל), Esther 8:13, Sir.11:33 33:26 (Sir.33:26)* ;] 
a malefactor, criminal: Luc 23:32-33, 39, 2 Timothée 2:9.†

G2558.def:
κακουχέω, -ῶ
(κακόν, ἔχω), [in LXX: 3Ki.2:26 11:39 (עָנָה pi., hith.)* ;] 
to ill-treat, hurt, torment: pass. ptcp., Hébreux 11:37 13:3.†

G2559.def:
κακόω, -ῶ
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi., עָנָה pi. ;] 
__1. to ill-treat, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), Actes 7:6, 19 12:1 18:10, 1 Pierre 3:13. 
__2. (not in cl.), to embitter (Psaumes 106:32): Actes 14:2,†

G2561.def:
κάκωσις, -εως, ἡ
(κακόω) [Ín LXX (for עָנִי, יָדַע, etc.): Exode 3:7, Jérémie 2:28, Wis.3:2, al. ;] 
ill-treatment: Actes 7:34 (LXX),†

G2562.def:
καλάμη, -ης, ἡ
(cf. κάλαμος), [in LXX chiefly for קַשׁ, Exode 5:12, Ésaïe 5:24, al. ;] 
a stalk of corn, stubble: 1 Corinthiens 3:12.†

G2564G.def:
καλέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for קרא ;] 
__1. to call, summon: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 20:8 25:14, Marc 3:31, Luc 19:13, Actes 4:18; before ἐκ, Matthieu 2:15 (LXX); metaphorically, 1 Pierre 2:9. 
__2. to call to one's house, invite: Luc 14:16, 1 Corinthiens 10:27, Apocalypse 19:9; εἰς τ. γάμους, Matthieu 22:3, 9 Luc 14:8, 9 Jean 2:2; ὁ καλέσας, Luc 7:39; οἱ κεκλημένοι, Matthieu 22:8; metaphorically, of inviting to partake of the blessings of the kingdom of God (Dalman, Words, 118f.): Romains 8:30 9:24, 25 1 Corinthiens 7:17, 18; before εἰς, 1 Corinthiens 1:9, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:12, 1 Timothée 6:12; ὁ καλῶν (καλέσας), of God, Galates 1:6 5:8, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:24, 1 Pierre 1:15, 2 Pierre 1:3; οἱ κεκλκλημένοι, Hébreux 9:15; before ἐν (ἐπί), 1 Corinthiens 7:15, Galates 5:13, Éphésiens 4:4, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:7; κλήσει, Éphésiens 4:1, 2 Timothée 1:9. 
__3. to call, name call by name: pass., Matthieu 2:23, Luc 1:32, al.; καλούμενος, Luc 7:11, Actes 7:58, al.; ὁ κ. (Deiss., BS, 210), Luc 6:15 22:3 23:33, Actes 10:1, Apocalypse 12:9, al.; with pred nom., Matthieu 5:9, Luc 1:35, Romains 9:26, Jacques 2:23, 1 Jean 3:1. (Cf. ἀντι-, ἐν-, εἰσ- (-μαι), ἐπι-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-καλέω.)

G2564H.def:
καλέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for קרא ;] 
__1. to call, summon: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 20:8 25:14, Marc 3:31, Luc 19:13, Actes 4:18; before ἐκ, Matthieu 2:15 (LXX); metaphorically, 1 Pierre 2:9. 
__2. to call to one's house, invite: Luc 14:16, 1 Corinthiens 10:27, Apocalypse 19:9; εἰς τ. γάμους, Matthieu 22:3, 9 Luc 14:8, 9 Jean 2:2; ὁ καλέσας, Luc 7:39; οἱ κεκλημένοι, Matthieu 22:8; metaphorically, of inviting to partake of the blessings of the kingdom of God (Dalman, Words, 118f.): Romains 8:30 9:24, 25 1 Corinthiens 7:17, 18; before εἰς, 1 Corinthiens 1:9, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:12, 1 Timothée 6:12; ὁ καλῶν (καλέσας), of God, Galates 1:6 5:8, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:24, 1 Pierre 1:15, 2 Pierre 1:3; οἱ κεκλκλημένοι, Hébreux 9:15; before ἐν (ἐπί), 1 Corinthiens 7:15, Galates 5:13, Éphésiens 4:4, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:7; κλήσει, Éphésiens 4:1, 2 Timothée 1:9. 
__3. to call, name call by name: pass., Matthieu 2:23, Luc 1:32, al.; καλούμενος, Luc 7:11, Actes 7:58, al.; ὁ κ. (Deiss., BS, 210), Luc 6:15 22:3 23:33, Actes 10:1, Apocalypse 12:9, al.; with pred nom., Matthieu 5:9, Luc 1:35, Romains 9:26, Jacques 2:23, 1 Jean 3:1. (Cf. ἀντι-, ἐν-, εἰσ- (-μαι), ἐπι-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-καλέω.)

G2565.def:
καλλιέλαιος, ου, ἡ
the garden olive (opposite to ἀγριέλ-): Romains 11:24.†

G2566.def:
καλλίων, -ον 
compar. of καλός, see: καλῶς 
καλῶς 
adv. (καλός), [in LXX for parts and derivatives of יָטַב ;] 
finely, rightly, well: Luc 6:48, 1 Corinthiens 14:17, Galates 4:17 5:7, Jacques 2:3; λέγειν, λαλεῖν, etc., Matthieu 15:7, Marc 7:6 12:28, Luc 6:26 20:39, Jean 4:17 8:48 13:13 18:23, Actes 28:25; as exclamation of approval, Marc 12:32, Romains 11:20; κ. ποιεῖν, Matthieu 12:12, 1 Corinthiens 7:37-38 Jacques 2:8, 19; with dative of person(s) (cl. accusative; WM, § 32, 1 β), Luc 6:27; with accusative of thing(s), Marc 7:37; with ptcp., Actes 10:33 (M, Pr., 131), Philippiens 4:14, 2 Pierre 1:19, 3Jn.6; προϊστάναι (-ασθαι), 1 Timothée 3:4 3:12 5:17; διακονεῖν, 1 Timothée 3:13; ἀνατρέφεσθαι, Hébreux 13:18; ironically, Marc 7:9, 2 Corinthiens 11:4 (but see CGT, in l); κ. ἔχειν, to be well: Marc 16:18. Compar., κάλλιον (for superl., B1., § 44, 3), very well: Actes 25:10.†

G2567.def:
καλο-διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ 
a teacher of that which is good: Tite 2:3.†

G2569.def:
καλο-ποιέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Lévitique 5:4 F (καλῶς π., B) * ;] 
to do well, act honourably: 2 Thessaloniciens 3:13 (cf. Galates 6:9 τὸ καλὸν π.).†

G2570G.def:
καλός, -ή, -όν, 
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹבָה ,טוֹב, also for יָפֶה, etc. ;] 
__1. primarily, of outward form ("related to . . . ἀγαθός as the appearance to the essence," Cremer, 339), fair, beautiful: λίθοι (BV, goodly), Luc 21:5. 
__2. In reference to use, of that which is well adapted to its ends, good, excellent: of fish, τ. καλά (opposite to σαπρά), Matthieu 13:48; σπέρμα, Matthieu 13:24, 27, 37, 38; καρπός, Matthieu 3:10 7:17-19 12:33, Luc 3:9 [WH] 6:43; δένδρον (opposite to σαρπόν), Matthieu 12:33, Luc 6:43; γῆ, Matthieu 13:8, 23 Marc 4:8, 20 Luc 8:15; τ. ἅλας, Marc 9:50, Luc 14:34; ὁ νόμος, Romains 7:16, 1 Timothée 1:8; διδασκαλία, 1 Timothée 4:6; καρδία κ. καὶ ἀγαθή, Luc 8:15; παραθήκη, 2 Timothée 1:14; μέτρον, Luc 6:38; βαθμός, 1 Timothée 3:13; θεμέλιος, 1 Timothée 6:19; τὸ κ., 1 Thessaloniciens 5:21; μαργαρίται, Matthieu 13:45; οἶνος, Jean 2:10; ποιμήν, Jean 10:11, 14; διάκονος, 1 Timothée 4:6; οἰκονόμος, 1 Pierre 4:10; στρατιώτης, 2 Timothée 2:3; στρατεία, 1 Timothée 1:18; ἀγών, 1 Timothée 6:12, 2 Timothée 4:7; ὁμολογία, 1 Timothée 6:12, 13; ἔργον, Matthieu 26:10, Marc 14:6, Jean 10:33, 1 Timothée 3:1; pl., Jean 10:32; καλόν, with inf. and dative, Matthieu 18:8, 9 1 Corinthiens 7:1, 26 9:15; id. with accusative and inf., Matthieu 17:4, Marc 9:5, 43, 45, 47, Luc 9:33, Hébreux 13:9; before εἰ, Matthieu 26:24, Marc 9:42 14:21; ἐάν, 1 Corinthiens 7:8. 
__3. Ethically, good, in the sense of right, fair, noble, honourable: Galates 4:18, Hébreux 5:14; ἔργα, Matthieu 5:16, 1 Timothée 5:10, 25 6:18, Tite 2:7, 14 3:8, 14 (Field, Notes, 223f.), Hébreux 10:24, 1 Pierre 2:12; ἀναστροφή, Jacques 3:13, 1 Pierre 2:12; συνείδησις, Hébreux 13:18; before ἐνώπιον, Romains 12:17, 2 Corinthiens 8:21, 1 Timothée 2:3; το] κ. ποιεῖν (κατεργάζεσθαι), Romains 7:18, 21 2 Corinthiens 13:7, Galates 6:9, Jacques 4:17; καλόν ἐστιν, with inf., Matthieu 15:26 (T, ἔξεστιν), Marc 7:27, Romains 14:21, Galates 4:18; μαρτυρία, 1 Timothée 3:7; ὄνομα, Jacques 2:7; καύχημα, 1 Corinthiens 5:6 (neg.); θεοῦ ῥῆμα, Hébreux 6:5. κ. does not occur in Re.†
SYN.: see: ἀγαθός.

G2570H.def:
καλός, -ή, -όν, 
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹבָה ,טוֹב, also for יָפֶה, etc. ;] 
__1. primarily, of outward form ("related to . . . ἀγαθός as the appearance to the essence," Cremer, 339), fair, beautiful: λίθοι (BV, goodly), Luc 21:5. 
__2. SYN.: see: ἀγαθός.

G2571.def:
κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(καλύπτω), [in LXX: Nombres 3:25 4:8 ff. (מְכַסֶּה), Exo_34:33 ff. (מַסְוֶה), etc. ;] 
a covering, veil: 2 Corinthiens 3:13-16 †

G2572.def:
καλύπτω 
[in LXX almost always for כָּסָה pi. ;] 
in cl., rare in prose, 
to cover: with accusative of person(s), Luc 23:30; with accusative of thing(s) and dative, Luc 8:16; pass., Matthieu 8:24; metaphorically, to veil, conceal: pf. ptcp. pass., Matthieu 10:26, 2 Corinthiens 4:3; of the forgiveness of sins (cf. Psaumes 32:5 85:2; DB, ii, 56b): 1 Pierre 4:8, Jacques 5:20; (seel. for καιομένη, WH, mg., Luc 24:32).†

G2573.def:
καλῶς 
adv. (καλός), [in LXX for parts and derivatives of יָטַב ;] 
finely, rightly, well: Luc 6:48, 1 Corinthiens 14:17, Galates 4:17 5:7, Jacques 2:3; λέγειν, λαλεῖν, etc., Matthieu 15:7, Marc 7:6 12:28, Luc 6:26 20:39, Jean 4:17 8:48 13:13 18:23, Actes 28:25; as exclamation of approval, Marc 12:32, Romains 11:20; κ. ποιεῖν, Matthieu 12:12, 1 Corinthiens 7:37-38 Jacques 2:8, 19; with dative of person(s) (cl. accusative; WM, § 32, 1 β), Luc 6:27; with accusative of thing(s), Marc 7:37; with ptcp., Actes 10:33 (M, Pr., 131), Philippiens 4:14, 2 Pierre 1:19, 3Jn.6; προϊστάναι (-ασθαι), 1 Timothée 3:4 3:12 5:17; διακονεῖν, 1 Timothée 3:13; ἀνατρέφεσθαι, Hébreux 13:18; ironically, Marc 7:9, 2 Corinthiens 11:4 (but see CGT, in l); κ. ἔχειν, to be well: Marc 16:18. Compar., κάλλιον (for superl., B1., § 44, 3), very well: Actes 25:10.†

G2574.def:
κάμηλος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ 
[in LXX for גָּמַל ;] 
camel: Matthieu 3:4, Marc 1:6; in proverbs, Matthieu 19:24 23:24, Marc 10:25, Luc 18:25 (on the seel. κάμιλος, see WH, Notes, 151).†
κάμιλος, see: κάμηλος, and cf. Thayer; LS, s.v

G2575.def:
κάμινος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX: Genèse 19:28, Exode 19:18, Ésaïe 48:10, al. (כִּבְשָׁן, כּוּר), Dan LXX TH Daniel 3:6 ff. (אַתּוּן) ;] 
a furnace: Matthieu 13:42, 50, Apocalypse 1:15 9:2.†

G2576.def:
καμμύω
(syncopated form of καταμύω, used by Ep. and κοινή writers; Rutherford, NPhr., 426 f.) [in LXX: Ésaïe 6:10 (שָׁעַע hi.) Ésaïe 29:10 33:15 (עָצַם), La 3:44 AR* ;] 
to shut the eyes: τ. ὀφθαλμούς, Matthieu 13:15, Actes 28:27 (Isa, l.with).†

G2577G.def:
κάμνω 
[in LXX: Job 10:1 (קוּט ni.) Job 17:2, Wis.4:16 15:9, 4Ma.3:8 4Mac 7:13 * ;] 
__1. to work; hence, from the effect of continued work, 
__2. to be weary: Hébreux 12:3 
__3. to be sick: Jacques 5:15.†

G2577H.def:
κάμνω 
[in LXX: Job 10:1 (קוּט ni.) Job 17:2, Wis.4:16 15:9, 4Ma.3:8 4Mac 7:13 * ;] 
__1. to work; hence, from the effect of continued work, 
__2. to be weary: Hébreux 12:3 
__3. to be sick: Jacques 5:15.†

G2578.def:
κάμπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for כָּרַע, 4Ki.1:13, 2 Chroniques 29:29, Ésaïe 45:24 (23), al. ;] 
to bend, bow: with accusative of thing(s), γόνυ, τὰ γ.; with dative of person(s), τῇ Βάαλ, Romains 11:4 (LXX); πρὸς τ. πατέρα, Éphésiens 3:14; by meton., πᾶν γόνυ for πᾶς, Romains 14:11 (LXX) Philippiens 2:10 (cf. ἀνα-, συν-κάμπτω).†

G2580.def:
Κανά (Rec. -νᾶ), ἡ, 
indecl., 
Cana, of Galilee: Jean 2:1, 11 4:46 21:2.†

G2581.def:
Καναναῖος, -ου, ὁ
(late Heb. קָנָא), 
a Cananæan or Zealot (cf. ζηλωτής): Matthieu 10:4, Marc 3:18 (Rec. -νίτης).†

G2583.def:
κανών, -όνος, ὁ
(cf. κάννα, and Heb. קָנֶה, a reed), [in LXX: Michée 7:4, Jdth.13:6, 4Ma.7:21 (and in Aq., Psaumes 19:5, Job 38:5)* ;] 
__1. a rod or bar (Jth, l.with). 
__2. a measuring rule; hence, metaph, 
__3. a rule or standard: Galates 6:16. 
__4. a limit (RV, province): 2 Corinthiens 10:13-16. (For the history of the word and esp. its later meanings, see Westc., Canon, App. A; cf. also MM, Exp., xv; Cremer, 744.)†

G2584.def:
καφαρναούμ (Καπερ-, Rec., see WH, App. 160), ἡ (Heb. נַחוּם כָּפָר Nahum's village) 
Capernaum: Matthieu 4:13, Marc 1:21, Jean 2:12, al

G2585.def:
καπηλεύω
(κάπηλος, a huckster, cf. Ésaïe 1:22 (LXX), Sir.26:29) 
to make a trade of (RV, mg., make merchandise of), or perhaps (cf. Isa, l.with) to corrupt (RV, tit.): 2 Corinthiens 2:17.†

G2586.def:
καπνός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX for עָשָׁן ;] 
smoke: Apocalypse 8:4 9:2-3, 17-18 14:11 15:8 18:9, 18 19:3; ἀτμὶς καπνοῦ, Actes 2:19 (LXX).†

G2587.def:
Καππαδοκία, -ας, ἡ 
Cappadocia, a province of Asia Minor: Actes 2:9, 1 Pierre 1:1.†

G2588.def:
καρδία, -ας, ἡ, 
[in LXX chiefly for לֵבָב ,לֵב ;] 
the heart, 
__1. the bodily organ which is regarded as the seat of life ( 2 Rois 18:14, 4Ki.9:24, al.). 
__2. In a psychological sense, the seat of man's collective energies, the focus of personal life, the seat of the rational as well as the emotional and volitional elements in human life, hence that wherein lies the moral and religious condition of the man (DB, ii, 317f.; DGG, ii, 344a); 
__(a) of the seat of physical life ( Juges 19:5, Psa.101 (102):5 103 (104):15): Actes 14:17, Jacques 5:5; 
__(b) of the seat of spiritual life: Matthieu 5:8, Marc 7:19, Luc 1:51, Actes 5:3, Romains 10:9, 10 Éphésiens 6:5, al.; pl., Matthieu 9:4, Marc 2:6, al.; opposite to στόμα, χείλεα, πρόσωπον, Matthieu 15:8, Marc 7:6, Romains 10:8, 9 2 Corinthiens 5:12; περιτομὴ καρδίας, Romains 2:29; ἐκ κ., Romains 6:17, 1 Pierre 1:22; ἀπὸ τῶν κ., Matthieu 18:35; ἐν ὅλῃ (ἐξ ὅλης), Matthieu 22:37, Marc 12:30" (LXX) ; γινώσκειν (ἐρευνᾶν, δοκιμάζειν) τὰς κ., Luc 16:15, Romains 8:27, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:4; to think, etc., ἐν τ. κ., Matthieu 9:4, Marc 2:6, Luc 12:45, Romains 10:6; συνιέναι (νοεῖν) τῇ κ., Matthieu 13:15, Jean 12:40; ἐπαχύνθη ἡ κ., Matthieu 13:15 (LXX); πωροῦν τὴν κ., Jean 12:40; κ. εὐθεῖα, Actes 8:21; πονηρά, Hébreux 3:12; ἀμετανόητος, Romains 2:5; εἶναι (ἔχειν) ἐν τῇ κ., 2 Corinthiens 7:3, Philippiens 1:7; ὀδύνη τῇ κ., Romains 9:2. 
__3. Of the central or innermost part of anything (of the pith of wood, Arist.): τ. γῆς, Matthieu 12:40 (Cremer, 343ff.).

G2589.def:
καρδιο-γνώστης, -ου, ὁ
(καρδία, γνώστης), 
knower of hearts: Actes 1:24 15:8.†

G2590.def:
καρπός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for פְּרִי ;] 
fruit: of trees, Matthieu 12:33 21:19, Marc 11:14, Luc 6:44 13:6-7; of vines, Matthieu 21:34, Marc 12:2, Luc 20:10, 1 Corinthiens 9:7; of fields, Marc 4:29, Luc 12:17, 2 Timothée 2:6, Jacques 5:7; βλαστάνειν, Jacques 5:18; ποιεῖν (cf. Heb. פְּרִי עָשָׂה), Matthieu 3:10 7:17-19 13:26, Luc 3:9 6:43 8:8 13:9, Apocalypse 22:2; διδόναι, Matthieu 13:8, Marc 4:7-8; φέρειν, Matthieu 7:18, Jean 12:24 15:2, 4-5 15:8, 16; ἀποδιδόναι, Matthieu 21:41, Apocalypse 22:2; ὁ κ. τ. κοιλίας (בֶּטֶן פְּרִי, Deutéronome 28:4), Luc 1:42; τ. ὀσφύος (Genèse 30:2, al.), Actes 2:30. 
Metaphorical, 
__(a) of works, deeds: Matthieu 3:8 7:16, 20 21:43, Luc 3:8, Jean 15:3, 16; τ. πνεύματος, Galates 5:22; τ. φωτός, Éphésiens 5:9; τ. δικαιοσύνης, Philippiens 1:11; σφραγίζεσθαι τὸν κ. (Deiss., BS, 238 f.), Romains 15:28; κ. ἀγαθοί, Jacques 3:17; 
__(b) of advantage, profit: Philippiens 1:22 4:17; ἔχειν, Romains 1:13 6:21-22. συνάγειν, Jean 4:36; κ. τ. δικαιοσύνης, Hébreux 12:11, Jacques 3:18; of praise, καρπὸν χειλέων (Osée 14:2, al.; cf. Æsch., Eum., 830): Hébreux 13:15.†

G2592.def:
καρπο-φορέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Habacuc 3:17 (פָּרַח), Wis.10:7 * ;] 
to bear fruit: χόρτον, Marc 4:28 (cf. Wis, l.with). Metaphorical, of conduct: Matthieu 13:23, Marc 4:20, Luc 8:15, Romains 7:4-5, Colossiens 1:10; mid., Colossiens 1:6.†

G2593.def:
καρπο-φόρος, -ον
(καρπύς, φέρω), [in LXX: Jérémie 2:21 (זֶרַע), Psaumes 107:34 148:9 (פְּרִי) * ;] 
fruitful: Actes 14:17.†

G2594.def:
καρτερέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Job 2:9 (חָזַק hi.), Ésaïe 42:14 (פָּאָה), Sir.2:2 12:15, 2 12:1-18, 4Macc 7:1-23 * ;] 
to be steadfast, patient: Hébreux 11:27 (cf. προσ-καρτερέω).†

G2595.def:
κάρφος, -εος (-ους) τό 
[in LXX: Genèse 8:11 (טָרַף) * ;] 
a small dry stalk, a twig; metaphorically, of a minor fault: Matthieu 7:3-5, Luc 6:41-42.†

G2597.def:
κατα-βαίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָרַד ;] 
to go or come down, descend. 
__1. Of persons: Matthieu 3:16 24:17, Luc 2:51 6:17 10:31 17:31 19:5-6, Jean 4:47, 49 4:51 5:7, Actes 7:34 8:15 10:20 20:10 23:10 24:1, 22 Éphésiens 4:10. before ἀπό, Matthieu 8:1 14:29 27:40, 42 Marc 3:22 15:30, Luc 10:30, Jean 6:38, Actes 25:7, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:16; ἐκ, Matthieu 17:9; ἐκ τ. οὐρανοῦ, Matthieu 28:2, Marc 9:9, Jean 1:32 3:13 6:33, 41-42 6:50-51, 58 Apocalypse 10:1 18:1 20:1; εἰς, Marc 1:10, Luc 10:30 18:14, Jean 2:12, Actes 7:15 8:38 14:25 16:8 18:22 25:6, Romains 10:7, Éphésiens 4:9; ἐπί, with accusative loc., Jean 6:16; with accusative of person(s), Luc 3:22, Jean 1:33, 51; ἐν, Jean 5:4; πρός, with accusative of person(s), Actes 10:21 14:11, Apocalypse 12:12. 
__2. Of things: σκεῦος, Actes 10:11 11:5; βροχή, Matthieu 7:25, 27; λαῖλαψ, Luc 8:23; before ἀπό, Luc 9:54, Actes 8:26, Jacques 1:17; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Luc 22:44 (WH, R, mg., reject); ἐκ τ. οὐρανοῦ before ἀπό, Apocalypse 3:12 21:2, 10; id. before εἰς, Apocalypse 13:13; ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Apocalypse 16:21. Fig., κ. ἕως ᾄδον, Matthieu 11:23, Luc 10:15, WH, txt., Tr., mg. (καταβιβασθήση, T, WH, mg., RV), (cf. συν-καταβαίνω).†

G2598.def:
κατα-βάλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל hi. ;] 
__1. to cast down, prostrate: metaphorically, pass., 2 Corinthiens 4:9. 
__2. to put down, lay down: metaphorically, mid., with accusative, θεμέλιον, Hébreux 6:1.†

G2599.def:
κατα-βαρέω, -ῶ 
to weigh down: metaphorically, with accusative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 12:16.†
